title: Helwit Raspberry-Liquorice Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Raspberry-Liquorice Nicotine Pouches combine two striking flavour notes-sharp, juicy Raspberry and dark, earthy Liquorice-into a distinctive pouch that stands apart from the usual fruit or mint options. This unconventional pairing balances tart berry brightness with the rich, herbal complexity of Liquorice for a flavour that's both surprising and satisfying. Each pouch contains 7mg of nicotine and is made using soft, plant-based materials for comfort and discretion. Designed to sit neatly under the lip, these pouches release nicotine gradually with no smoke, vapour or odour. Crafted in Sweden using climate-compensated methods, Raspberry-Liquorice is ideal for pouch users who enjoy more adventurous flavour combinations in a clean, tobacco-free format. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
